label: CBFB::MYH11

sections.text: CBFB encodes the non-DNA-binding beta subunit of the core-binding factor transcription complex.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 865 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: MYH11 encodes smooth-muscle myosin heavy chain, a contractile motor protein.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 4629 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: CBFB::MYH11 formed cytoplasmic aggregates that recruited RUNX1 in hematopoietic-cell models. Immunofluorescence of primary fusion-positive AML samples also supported predominantly cytoplasmic localization.

audit_evidence.location: Results: RUNX1 colocalizes with cytoplasmic CBFB::MYH11; Figures 4 and 5A-B; Supplemental Figures 2-3
audit_evidence.scope: Model domain comparisons plus actual primary AML imaging; no claim that RUNX1 function is simply extinguished.

sections.text: Under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria, CBFB::MYH11 AML is assigned to the favorable genetic-risk group.

audit_evidence.location: Table 6, 2022 ELN risk classification by genetics at initial diagnosis
audit_evidence.scope: Favorable CBF; intermediate t(9;11); adverse DEK::NUP214, other KMT2A, MECOM and KAT6A::CREBBP categories.

report_comment.text: CBFB encodes the non-DNA-binding beta subunit of the core-binding factor transcription complex. MYH11 encodes smooth-muscle myosin heavy chain, a contractile motor protein. CBFB::MYH11 formed cytoplasmic aggregates that recruited RUNX1 in hematopoietic-cell models. Immunofluorescence of primary fusion-positive AML samples also supported predominantly cytoplasmic localization. Under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria, CBFB::MYH11 AML is assigned to the favorable genetic-risk group.
